text:
emily: Heads-up 10min planning thread: smaller targeted nurture for priority accounts tied to benchmark release. Goal: 1) get product team RSVPs 2) secure pilot requests from 10 named accounts.
raj: list filter: account_tier in ('enterprise','strategic') AND last_touch < 90d AND engaged_topics @> ARRAY['inference','cost']
carmen: messaging approach: micro-personalization per account: reference last touchpoint + 1-sentence value prop, include case snippet. Keep sender as 'Account Team at Redwood'.
aj: suggest 3-email microscript: invite -> tailored case study -> CTA to book pilot (cal link). include a plain-text friendly variant for syndication.
kevin: deliverability: use company-dedicated IP, throttle 200/min for enterprise seeds, whitelist internal recipient domains to avoid blocking.
ops-bot: IP pool "enterprise-seed" warmness 96%.
emily: timeline: initial outreach Mon AM, follow-ups Tues and Thurs. need copy for 10 accounts FRI.
raj: tracking: crm: add activity 'bench_invite_sent' + email_open, link_click events. tag account records with 'pilot_interest' if demo link clicked.
carmen: subject lines (tailored): 
- "[AcctName]  Quick invite: benchmark walk-through for your infra"
- "See cost wins we found for teams like [AcctName]"
preheader: "Join our hands-on walkthrough + Q&A"
aj: use {{account_name}} and {{last_touch_person}} merge fields. Include single-click calendar booking link with capacity controls.
emily: assets: include 1-pager PDF with summary + ROI numbers. carmen will adapt case snippet per account.
kevin: enable click tracking and override link shortener so CRM captures lead source.
raj: legal: include standard enterprise notice, cc legal@redwood.ai for signoff.
carmen: I'll author copy in docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/enterprise/pilot_invites. need approvals by Fri noon.
emily: QA: send internal seeds to emily, aj, raj, kevin + 3 customer POCs.
ops-bot: automation: set follow-up if no click in 48h -> send reminder variant B.
emily: blockers?
kevin: none.
aj: none.
emily: perfect. we'll roll Monday morning once approvals done. thanks everyone :handshake:
